mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey—one that invites us to walk alongside those who faced some of the darkest moments in human history. Together, we’ll step into the world of Primo Levi’s unforgettable work, If This Is a Man • The Truce, where every page is a testament to both suffering and resilience. Imagine being thrust into a place where your identity, your very sense of right and wrong, is pushed to the absolute edge. That’s where Levi, a chemist and a Jew, found himself—in Auschwitz. But what emerges isn’t just a story of survival against impossible odds; it’s about holding onto dignity, memory, and meaning, even when everything around you is designed to strip them away. We’ll witness moments of solidarity and grace, heartbreak and hope, all in the unyielding shadow of the Holocaust. And just when you think the ordeal is over, the journey keeps going. With liberation comes a new struggle—the uncertain, sometimes chaotic return to a world that's been forever changed. Through The Truce, Levi guides us across a fractured Europe, searching for home, and maybe even for himself, while carrying the scars of the past. Along the way, we’ll explore what it really means to rebuild, to remember, and to move forward when hope flickers but never quite fades. So, as we begin, let’s keep our hearts open to the questions that echo through Levi’s story—about memory, responsibility, and the fragile threads that hold us all together. Here’s to discovering the light that can persist, even after the darkest of nights.
